about.title: About
about.body: I visit Ueno Park a lot, and I’ve always wondered what the names of these cute birds are — so I made this site. The idea and visual style are inspired by AvianVisitors (theodore.net).

data.title: Data source
data.body: Prevalence comes from curated eBird histogram exports for this site. The Guide is a fixed list of species; values can be hand-tuned in admin when passage weeks need care. Atlas pages link out to eBird for full species accounts.

art.title: Illustrations
art.body: Cutouts follow a kachō-e (bird-and-flower) print style, generated with anatomy references and human review before they appear on the collage. The packing layout and collage interaction are inspired by AvianVisitors (theodore.net).
